script_hooks.logic:
Let v be the default update-transition step.
If v, then return v.
Let part be part 2 of the enemy.
Let part2 be part 3 of the enemy.
If part is dead and part2 is dead, then
  Set the script register's 'tentaclesDeadFlag' to true.
  If this state → get-state-id is 12, then return 13.
  If this state → get-state-id is 22, then return 23.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg1, arg2.
Let memberValues be the settings of arg2.
If (the register of the state machine's 'parent')'s 'tentaclesDeadFlag' is false, then set memberValues's 'nextStateId' to 22.
Otherwise, set memberValues's 'nextStateId' to 23.
